claim: G27-A: a typed, idempotent mechanical workshop broker permits bounded candidate worktree/write/test/diff/discard operations inside a fixed Docker sandbox while denying undeclared host/filesystem/network reach; an intentionally permissive synthetic profile is detected.
non_claims: Containment for the tested Docker boundary, not a kernel security proof, Soul's project formation, executable candidate authorship/promotion, Mattermost or live service reach.

reading: Constitution C-060–067/090–105, Soul Parts 6.7/9/10.4–10.5/11 and complete ledger; POC_SPEC §15; WORK_PROTOCOL W-100–109; ACCEPTANCE G27. Applicable clauses reread at closure.

falsifiers: plan.md freezes successful create/write/read/test/diff/discard; missing IDs, replay/conflict, path/symlink escape, forbidden authority targets, forged runner/network settings, synthetic-secret/socket/host reach tests, output/time limits and permissive synthetic profile detection.

Use existing local pinned image with explicit shell entrypoint; no new image pull, real secret mount, user service stop or live network. Only runtime/g27 new test roots and evidence/G27 may be mutated.
